description: Reads one build-log post by its slug. Use it after cotal_list_posts or cotal_search has given you a slug and you need the full article. Returns the post as markdown (title, summary, date, author, full body), with the same fields structured.
name: cotal_get_post

by_agent.description: true when an agent on the mesh wrote it (a human published it).

markdown.description: The full post as markdown, title included.

slug.description: Post slug; pass it to cotal_get_post.

title: Read a build-log post
